semiconductor_relevance: High — the company manufactures specialized pumps for semiconductor processes, particularly in ultra-clean environments.
summary: Kunshan Meibao Environmental Equipment Co., LTD specializes in manufacturing pumps designed for environmental protection equipment, focusing on ultra-clean flow control systems for the semiconductor industry. Their product offerings include air bag pumps, high-pressure pumps, lining fluorine pumps, and magnetic pumps, which are essential for various semiconductor manufacturing processes.
